description: Wave 6D-6 read-only parity probes confirming vanilla combat, weapons, weapon mods, perks, combat styles, projectiles, and VATS behaviors.

batches.title: Wave 6D-6 confirmed combat, weapons, mods, perks & VATS observations

probes.claim: SD-12: Test whether EnergyResist cuts Energy weapon hit damage alone or alongside DamageResist on WeapLaserRifle.
probes.expected: Record GetHitHealthDamage for WeapLaserRifle at (ER=0,DR=0), (ER=50,DR=0), (ER=0,DR=30), and (ER=50,DR=30).

script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d6_01_energy_fire_emp_resist_and_dr|n=%g|base=%.3f|h(0,0)=%.3f|h(er50,0)=%.3f|h(0,dr30)=%.3f|h(er50,dr30)=%.3f" iN fB0 fH0 fH1 fH2 fH3

probes.claim: Determine exact order of Ammo DT Mod (10mm Hollow Point x3 DT, x1.75 dmg) vs Toughness defender DT (+3) vs ShotgunSurgeon attacker DT ignore (-10).
probes.expected: Compare hDmg for 10mm Pistol (std vs HP) on DT=5 target with/without Toughness, and HuntingShotgun+Slug on DT=15 with/without ShotgunSurgeon.

probes.claim: SD-03: Verify whether rInv.GetCalculatedWeaponDamage distinguishes two inventory units of the same weapon with different conditions (100% vs 25%) and mod flags (0 vs 7).
probes.expected: Record per-invref health, mod flags, and GetCalculatedWeaponDamage for both units (nvse_gaps.rs:339-349 always picks first inventory group).

probes.claim: SD-13: Verify Luck->CritChance AV, Finesse/BuiltToDestroy, live critical hit damage with BetterCriticals (x1.5), HeavyHanded (x0.4), both stacked, and w.crit_mult==0.
probes.expected: Record derived CritChance AV and live critical hit hDmg/baseDmg/critFlag across none, BetterCriticals, HeavyHanded, both, and critMult=0.

probes.expected: Record effect count/trait readback, duplicate add behavior, and GetCalculatedActorSpread/Damage with Ammo10mm vs Ammo10mmHollowPoint vs Ammo10mmJHPHandLoad.
